input:
Earlier scenes:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

This scene:
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气：住在离墓地太近的地方，会害得孟子受到不好的影响，害得Sb. + V.
- 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书：孟子现在没有朋友，因为他老是读书

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住离墓地太近：住得离墓地太近，an adjective phrase describing the degree of a verb needs the complement marker 得 after the verb.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 害得孟子的心气：会影响孟子的学习，害得 must introduce a complete result or consequence; 心气 alone does not state what result happened.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 老是：一直，老是 carries a negative, complaining tone, while reading because he has no friends is neutral here.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：他和妈妈，use pronouns for characters mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence; this follows the close re-occurrence pronoun rule.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 跟子思老师住：跟他住，after 子思老师 has been named earlier in the same sentence, use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟母帮子思：她帮他，both characters were named in the previous sentence, so close re-occurrences should use pronouns.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 子思帮孟母：他帮她，use pronouns when both referents were mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence.
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子现在没有朋友：他现在没有朋友，孟子 was referred to as her son in the preceding sentence, so a pronoun is natural for this close re-occurrence.
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬到子思老师的家：搬到了子思老师的家，use 了 after 搬到 because the move is a completed event in the narrative.
10. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): ，他老是读书：，所以他一直读书，add 所以 after a 因为-clause to mark the cause-and-effect relation.

items.reason: 住 needs a complement structure here, and 住得离墓地太近 is grammatical.
害得 requires a person plus a harmful resulting clause, and 心气 alone cannot fill that result.
老是 is acceptable for saying that he habitually reads all the time; its mildly negative tone is not an error here.
孟母 is being introduced as a name/designation, so repeating the names is acceptable and helps identify both people.
子思老师 has already been named in the same sentence, so 跟他住 follows the close-reference rule.
Both people have just been mentioned, so 她帮他 is the expected close re-reference.
The two referents were named in the immediately preceding sentence, so pronouns are expected.
孟子 is needed to avoid ambiguity with 子思老师, and 他 could refer to either male character.
In this series of actions, the earlier 搬到 need not take 了; the series rule would place 了 on the final action instead.
The causal relation is reversed: he has no friends because he always reads, not necessarily the reverse.
